text.p: Anacomp Inc, which restructured financially and emerged from Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code in fiscal 1996, said on Wednesday it reached an agreement to refinance its senior secured debt.
The agreement, with Lehman Brothers, would reduce interest charges and improve liquidity, the company said.
Lehman has agreed to underwrite a new $115 million debt facility to replace Anacomp's existing $97.9 million senior secured notes, the company said.
The new debt facility wuold consist of $90 million in term loans and a revolver of up to $25 million, it said.
Anacomp said it expected the refinancing to be completed in late January.
The company said the agreement would save Anacomp about $3 million in interest payments in the first 12 months, and would provide greater flexibility.
